data_fields.name: variant_range_low
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: inclusive lower bound of a numbered variant range (one digit as written, line 103)

data_fields.name: variant_range_high
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: inclusive upper bound; expansion runs while n <= high

data_fields.name: missing_line_policy
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: report missing lines only, no failing status

best_idea: Before a zone ships, expand each ranged bark or dialogue reference into explicit line ids and fail the test if any id is missing from the locale table.
decision_why: Take the expand-and-diff check as a zone-data test; reject the version-control lookup and Windows tooling, which do not fit Frankendom. Dialogue is client text, so this guards content, not outcomes.
acceptance: A server test loads every zone's NPC line sets; a reference bark_guard_1..4 with bark_guard_4 missing from the locale table fails the test and names bark_guard_4.
